BACKGROUND
The construction of the Happy Jack Landfill expansion resulted in the removal of aportionof Duke Energy's
road used to accessthree wind turbines along thewest side of the landfill expansion area.The City of
Cheyenne(City)and Duke Energy(Duke)have discussed alternate locations for an access road over the
course of the last several months.On June1,2021the City requested that Solid Waste Professionals of
Wyoming(SWPW)evaluate theroad alignment options present by Duke.SWP W evaluated there-route
estimates from Dan Hart Patrol, Inc.(DHP); and, prepared cost estimates for engineering design,
surveying, and construction oversight.
ROUTE EVALUATION
SWP W evaluated there-route options provided by Duke as shown in Attachment A andre-route options
provided by the City in Attachment B.
Thereroute option provideby Duke is notfeasible, as theroute is inthe same location as the spoil
stockpiles constructed as part of the landfill expansion project.Additionally, Duke suggested salvaging
theroadway surfacing from the abandoned accessroad alongthe southsideof thelandfill expansion.A
large portion of thisroad has been removed aspart of thelandfill project and salvaging the remaining
road base will be challenging dueto the woven geo textile placed beneath theroad base.Sw Pw
recommends installing new road base over the new access road.
The City provided two route options.Option1is approximately 3,800LF and is located along the north
boundary of the new spoil Stockpile 2and Stockpile3.Option2utilizes the existing landfill entrance and
is approximately533LFlong.SWP W determined Option2was not feasible due to the overhead power
lines and power poles which would need to be relocated.
Theroute SWp w ultimately chose for the accessroad is similar to the route identified in Option 1
presented by the City.Theroute can befound in the Construction Drawings provided as Attachment C.
